title: Danger / Keep away
changes: Reconstructed the visible sign face, support arrangement and separable printed layout from this source specimen.
New native rectangles, clean curves, controlled pictograms and editable text. No auto-contour trace or embedded raster.
Provided blank physical geometry, face-only export, editable example text, stable outlined example and separate branding guides.
limits: Clean template coordinates regularize scan skew, ink spread and small wobbles; not recovered original production artwork.
Example lettering uses metric-compatible Arimo/Tinos substitutes. Exact historical typesetting is not authenticated. No font files are distributed.
Pictograms are authored illustrative reconstructions, not certified contemporary traffic or safety symbols.
Provincial/Hydro example identity, where present, reuses supplied project vector artwork; it is replaceable and is not newly authenticated by this pass.
Dimension leaders, page captions, backgrounds, grass and unrelated overlapping objects are excluded from the object. Source proofs stay unmasked.
The scanned danger panel appears nearly neutral; the accompanying manual explicitly specifies black on yellow. The editable example uses yellow; it is not a claim about the scan’s measured pigment.
geometry_pass_scope: This asset was inspected in the trailer/sign pass; this is not a claim that every source pixel has been reproduced.
